HIV-positive patients with MCD should be evaluated for HHV-8 serology and treated appropriately, but should also be considered for antiretrovial therapy and chemotherapy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
MCD should be considered in the differential diagnosis in HIV-positive patients presenting with lymphadenopathy.
